01 · PHYSICAL LAYER
HARDWARE

INA226 · R100

and physical motion

03 · TRUSTED RUNTIME
BACKEND
Schema v1 validation
Serial bridge · COM13
WebSocket + REST API
Persistent NDJSON log
Hardware graph
Validate · Stream · Store

div.div:
04 · AI REASONING
NVIDIA NEMOTRON
ON NEBIUS
Grounded hardware context
Ranked hypotheses
Evidence IDs
Read-only tool proposal
AI proposes — never writes
directly to hardware

div.div:
05 · CONTROL BOUNDARY
SAFETY POLICY
DEFAULT DENY
Voltage/current limits
PWM + duration limits
Allowlisted tools only
Human + physical interlock
Approve or reject

div.div:
06 · CLOSED LOOP
VERIFY
Fresh device sample
Encoder RPM evidence
Before / after delta
Pass / fail event
Auditable trace
No fresh evidence =
no recovery claim
